title: Characterizing Heterogeneous Rates in Finite Mixture Estimation via Partial Optimal Transport
summary: Parameter estimation in finite mixture models can exhibit highly heterogeneous convergence behavior: locally isolated components may be estimated substantially faster than groups of competing components. Existing analyses based on Wasserstein distances typically characterize only the worst-case rate and therefore do not fully capture this local heterogeneity. In this paper, we introduce a Voronoi-based partial optimal transport (VPOT) framework for obtaining refined local and global convergence guarantees for the maximum likelihood estimator of the mixing measure.
